name: Citizen Complaint Response Workflow
description: Summarizes citizen complaints, drafts official responses, and requires human approval with up to 3 revision cycles.

nodes.prompt: Summarize the following complaint and categorize it: {input.complaint}
Draft an official response letter based on this summarized complaint: {artifact.summary}

nodes.label: Review Draft Response
nodes.reason: Please approve the draft or request a revision.

explanation: The workflow sequentially summarizes the complaint and drafts a response. It then pauses at a human_gate for staff review. If the staff selects 'Revise', it cycles back to the drafting node. The cycle is bounded by policy.max_iterations set to 3 to prevent infinite loops.
warnings: The workflow will suspend indefinitely if the human_gate is not attended to by a staff member.
If the 3-iteration limit is reached due to repeated 'Revise' selections, the workflow will terminate automatically.
